# Cloudflare Whiteboard

Cloudflare Whiteboard is an anonymous realtime SVG whiteboard reference implementation built with React, Cloudflare Workers, SQLite Durable Objects, and hibernatable WebSockets.

## Documentation

- [Cloudflare Durable Objects](https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/)
- [Project source](https://github.com/Gryczka/cloudflare-whiteboard)

Board capability URLs are private credentials and should not be indexed, retained, or disclosed.
